header.title: FileUploader
header.description: Field to upload files by dragging them or with a button. Filters by type and size, limits the number of files and shows the progress of each upload.

playground.description: Try the main props and copy the generated code.
playground.label: Attachments
playground.helperText: Drop a file or use Browse files. Progress is simulated.

base.title: Base
base.description: Dropzone with a label, custom copy and simulated progress with `simulateUpload`.

texts.label: Attachments
texts.helperText: Drop a file or use Browse files. Progress is simulated.

multiple.title: Multiple
multiple.description: `multiple` allows several files; `maxFiles` limits how many.

texts.label: Documents

buttonOnly.title: Button only
buttonOnly.description: `droppable={false}` replaces the dropzone with a button.

imagesOnly.description: `fileTypes` filters the picker and rejects other file types.

fileTypes.description: Copy for the dropzone, the button and the allowed types comes from the parent.

texts.label: Data files

minMaxFiles.title: Min and max files
minMaxFiles.description: `minFiles` marks the field as invalid below the minimum; `maxFiles` stops the picker.

texts.helperText: Between 2 and 4 files. The picker stops at the maximum.

maxSize.title: Max size
maxSize.description: `maxSize` (in bytes) rejects files over the limit.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: `isDisabled` blocks the dropzone and the actions.

error.title: Error
error.description: `errorMessage` marks the field as invalid and forces the error border.

texts.label: Contract
texts.errorMessage: Upload a signed contract to continue.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: Three sizes: sm, md and lg.

borders.title: Borders
borders.description: `border` changes the border tone. It is forced to error when the field is invalid.

withTooltip.title: With tooltip

texts.label: Identity documents
texts.infoText: Accepted formats: PDF, JPG, or PNG. Max 5 MB.

customUpload.title: Custom upload
customUpload.description: Pass `onUpload` to send files to your API and report progress with onProgress. signal is aborted if the file is removed.

texts.label: Invoice
texts.helperText: This example uses a custom onUpload handler.

controlled.title: Controlled
controlled.description: Drive the file list with value and `onChange`.

fileEvents.title: File events
fileEvents.description: `onFileAdded` and `onFileRemoved` receive the current file list.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Besides the documented props, FileUploader accepts native <input> attributes (InputHTMLAttributes) except onChange, value, defaultValue, size, type and children. They are applied to the hidden <input type="file">; className goes to the dropzone (or button) and wrapperClassName to the root.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.dropzone: The dropzone uses role="button" and works with the keyboard; without a visible label it uses dropLabel as aria-label.
a11y.progress: Each file shows a bar with role="progressbar" and aria-valuenow.
a11y.remove: Remove buttons have an aria-label with the file name.
a11y.label: helperText, the allowed types and errorMessage are linked with aria-describedby; the error uses role="alert".

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Class names applied based on props. Useful for styling with CSS.

rules.title: Main dropzone text (`dropLabel`).
rules.name: File name.
rules.message: Helper or error text below the field.
rules.drag: Applied while files are dragged over the dropzone.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: FileUploader has no variables of its own: it uses these gem-system tokens. Redefine them in your `wrapperClassName` to change only this field.

items.--gem-color-border: Dashed dropzone border and each file border.
items.--gem-color-accent: Icon, drag border and uploading state.
items.--gem-color-primary-500: Icon background, progress bar and drag background.
items.--gem-color-bg-subtle: Hover background and file icon background.
items.--gem-radius-sm: File icon and remove button radius.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

props.title: Props
props.description: It also accepts native <input> attributes except `onChange`, value, `defaultValue`, size, type and children.

items.droppable: Shows the dropzone. With false, only a button.
items.fileTypes: Allowed types as a simple string, e.g. jpg/png/csv. Takes precedence over accept.
items.accept: Native accept filter (MIME or extensions). Used when `fileTypes` is omitted.
items.maxSize: Maximum size per file in bytes.
items.minFiles: Minimum number of files. The field is invalid below it.
items.maxFiles: Maximum number of files. Extra files are rejected.
items.simulateUpload: Animates a mock upload when `onUpload` is not provided.
items.label: Visible field label.
items.allowedText: Allowed types copy below the dropzone.
items.helperText: Hint below the field (hidden when `errorMessage` is shown).
items.errorMessage: Error copy. Marks the field as invalid.
items.infoText: Shows an info icon with this content.
items.border: Border tone. Forced to error when the field is invalid.
items.isDisabled: Disables the dropzone and file actions.
items.isRequired: Marks the field as required (aria-required + asterisk).
items.className: Extra classes for the dropzone or button.
items.wrapperClassName: Extra classes for the root container.
items.onChange: Fires when files are added or removed (not on progress ticks).
items.onFileAdded: Fires after files are added. Receives the current list.
items.onFileRemoved: Fires after a file is removed. Receives the current list.
items.onReject: Fires when files are rejected for type, size or count.
items.onUpload: Uploads each accepted file. Report progress with onProgress(0–100).
